limits: Known public release histories from ten selected Bitcoin ASIC/accessory projects are complete for this snapshot. This is not a claim that every project on the Internet has been found.
Direct main HEAD submodules are archived. Historical, nested and SDK dependencies are incomplete.
Language scan is not a full audit of every PDF, historical source and comment. Explicit pending review gaps remain.
Hardware compatibility is documented or claimed, not tested locally. Firmware images were not run.
Two original upstream bootloader header/hash anomalies remain preserved and indexed.
